rubric.role_summary: Legal Engineer working with law firms and legal teams on litigation and regulatory use cases, including discovery, demonstrations, onboarding, and tailored AI workflows across pre-sales and post-sales.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Legal Engineer working with law firms and legal teams on litigation and regulatory use cases, including discovery, demonstrations, onboarding, and tailored AI workflows across pre-sales and post-sales.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- JD or equivalent legal qualification.
- 3+ years practicing law in-house, at a law firm, or advising a corporate legal team.
- Experience working at or with law firms.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Cross-functional experience in business, operations, compliance, or product.
- Sales or customer-facing experience, such as law-firm business development or secondment.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools in legal practice.
- Understanding of law-firm workflows, challenges, and demands, including balancing legal risk with business priorities.
- Track record of partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
